code: sim1 <- function(n, beta=c(-3, rep(.5,10)), rho=.5) {  p <- length(beta)-1  xx <- lava::rmvn0(n,sigma=diag(nrow=p)*(1-rho)+rho)  y <- rbinom(n, 1, lava::expit(cbind(1,xx)%*%beta))  d <- data.frame(y=y, xx)  names(d) <- c("y",paste0("x",1:p))  return(d) }  set.seed(1) beta <- c(-2,rep(1,10)) d <- sim1(1e4, beta=beta) a1 <- naivebayes(y ~ ., data=d) a2 <- glm(y ~ ., data=d, family=binomial) #> Warning: glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred ## a3 <- randomForest(factor(y) ~ ., data=d, family=binomial)  d0 <- sim1(1e4, beta=beta) p1 <- predict(a1, newdata=d0) p2 <- predict(a2, newdata=d0, type="response") ## p3 <- predict(a3, newdata=d0, type="prob")  c2 <- calibration(p2, d0$y, method="isotonic") c1 <- calibration(p1, d0$y, breaks=100) if (interactive()) {   plot(c1)   plot(c2,col="red",add=TRUE)   abline(a=0,b=1)   with(c1$xy[[1]], points(pred,freq,type="b", col="red")) }  set.seed(1) beta <- c(-2,rep(1,10)) dd <- lava::csplit(sim1(1e4, beta=beta), k=3) mod <- naivebayes(y ~ ., data=dd[[1]]) p1 <- predict(mod, newdata=dd[[2]]) cal <- calibration(p1, dd[[2]]$y) p2 <- predict(mod, newdata=dd[[3]]) pp <- predict(c1, p2) cc <- calibration(pp, dd[[3]]$y) if (interactive()) {#'   plot(cal)   plot(cc, add=TRUE, col="blue") }

text: Risk regression binary exposure nuisance model odds-product. Let \(\) binary exposure, \(V\) set covariates, \(Y\) binary response variable, define \(p_a(v) = P(Y=1 \mid =, V=v), \\{0,1\}\). target parameter either relative risk $$\mathrm{RR}(v) = \frac{p_1(v)}{p_0(v)}$$ risk difference $$\mathrm{RD}(v) = p_1(v)-p_0(v)$$ assume target parameter model given either $$\log\{RR(v)\} = \alpha^t v$$ $$\mathrm{arctanh}\{RD(v)\} = \alpha^t v$$ similarly working linear nuisance model odds-product $$\phi(v) = \log\left(\frac{p_{0}(v)p_{1}(v)}{(1-p_{0}(v))(1-p_{1}(v))}\right) = \beta^t v$$. propensity model \(E(=1|V)\) also fitted using logistic regression working model $$\mathrm{logit}\{E(=1\mid V=v)\} = \gamma^t v.$$ odds-product model propensity model correct estimator efficient. , estimator consistent union model, .e., estimator double-robust sense one two models needs correctly specified get consistent estimate.

text: Calculating test statistics p-values onesided Zmax / minP test.z Given parameter estimates \((\widehat{\theta}_1, \ldots,  \widehat{\theta}_p)^\top\) approximate assymptotic covariance matrix \(\widehat{S}\), let \( Z_i = \frac{\widehat{\theta}_i -  \delta_i}{\operatorname{SE}(\widehat{\theta}_i)}\) , \(\operatorname{SE}(\widehat{\theta}_i) = \widehat{S}_{ii}\).
